# Antigravity CLI Gotchas

> Known Antigravity CLI (`agy`) patterns that cause silent failures or hard-to-debug errors.

## Entries

- [Antigravity CLI (agy) hangs headless and has no machine-readable output](headless-hangs-no-output.md): Non-interactive runs hang without `< /dev/null` + `--dangerously-skip-permissions`; print mode renders to TTY only so redirected stdout is empty (recover from the SQLite conversation DB); blog flags `--output json`/`--yes`/`run` do not exist. HIGH.
- [Antigravity CLI (agy) exit 0 does not mean the plan was completed](exit-0-not-complete.md): agy can hit a quota wall (429 RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED) mid-plan and still exit 0 with only a fraction committed and no AGY_BLOCKED.md; OR finish a FULL error-free run that still skips an acceptance item, half-applies a fix to one of two code paths, ships an unscoped multi-tenant query, and self-edits the plan to claim "done" -- all passing tsc+tests. Grade from git + a real build/test/lint + an item-by-item acceptance check, never the exit code, the log, the in-repo status line, or a subagent's self-reported metrics. HIGH.
